headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 18, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets secured a 4-1 win over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Francisco Alvarez leading the offense. Alvarez hit two home runs and drove in two runs in just three at-bats. Meanwhile, the Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, winning 10-0 in a one-sided matchup. Griffin Jax led the Red Sox pitching staff, while Anthony Seigler and Caleb Durbin were among the Rays' top performers at the plate.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. JoJo Romero has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the St. Louis Cardinals, retroactive to July 14, 2026. The Washington Nationals also lost Drew Millas to the 10-day injured list, while the Houston Astros placed Brice Matthews on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 14, 2026.

The Washington Nationals made a roster move, trading CF Robert Hassell III to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers also acquired RHP Lance McCullers Jr., LHP Colton Gordon, and cash from the Houston Astros in exchange for OF Jadyn Fielder.

top_news.title: **Rays Suffer 10-Run Shutout Loss to Red Sox**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, winning 10-0 in a one-sided matchup. Griffin Jax led the Red Sox pitching staff, while Anthony Seigler and Caleb Durbin were among the Rays' top performers at the plate.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall Short in Boston**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox edged out the Tampa Bay Rays 5-3 in a decisive matchup. Junior Caminero and Jonny DeLuca led the charge for the Red Sox, while Wilyer Abreu and Willson Contreras contributed for the Rays.

top_news.title: **Cardinals' Romero Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Left-handed pitcher JoJo Romero has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the St. Louis Cardinals, retroactive to July 14, 2026. The move comes as Romero deals with an injury.

top_news.title: **Nationals Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals traded CF Robert Hassell III to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash on July 16, 2026.
